styles.name: display
styles.sample: Financial services, personal service, by invitation.
styles.usage: Home hero H1 only, centred, in ink-head. payset.io sets it at 140/120 for three words; 120/104 fits a three-line headline. 52/50 under 768px.

styles.name: giant
styles.usage: Centred title of a section card (stone, dark or green). Two to six words. 48/46 under 768px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Left-aligned section titles on inner pages. 36/36 under 768px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Every payment followed through to arrival.
styles.usage: Title over a photo card, top left, in white. 30/32 under 768px.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Accounts in your company’s name and FX priced on your volume.
styles.usage: The H2 under the home hero, centred, in ink-head. One sentence. 22/28 under 768px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Tile titles, icon point titles, card titles.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Large money figures. Tabular numerals, space as thousands separator, ISO code after.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One named account manager who knows your business, your suppliers and your deadlines.
styles.usage: Paragraph under a giant or section title, centred in cards. Max 600px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each outgoing payment over 10 000 EUR has to be signed by two members.

styles.name: tile-body
styles.usage: Copy under a tile or icon-point title. Max 300px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. 14px in the nav and on tags.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Pay Set Limited is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority.
styles.usage: Nav links (weight 500), footer links, card meta.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow above inner-page titles, uppercase via text-transform, in ink-brand. Not used on the home page.
